reasons.detail: R1 — Both SDD flow procedure files now include an explicit requirement to inspect related shared regression tests when moving prompt guidance between flow skill/prompt files, with explicit placement-contract checks.
R2 — The updated procedure text explicitly requires checking both old-placement removal assertions and new-placement presence assertions when moving prompt guidance.

R3 — The added procedure text states guidance movement between flow skill or flow prompt files generally and explicitly says the rule applies to general prompt guidance movement, not a single guidance topic.

R4 — The added spec test directly inspects the SDD flow skill contract text and verifies it contains prompt-guidance movement checks tied to related shared regression tests, plus both old-placement removal and new-placement presence assertions.

R5 — `src/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md` was modified and the generated counterpart under `.agents/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md` was also updated with the same change, indicating the required upgrade-generated sync was applied.
